node.text: Small question, just a tiny concern. When installing NFTs I'm prompted with the below message "Third party applications will have access to your wallet". From a non technical persons perspective or newbie, I can see this being a big red flag for the acceptance of any apps/NFTs within the community. The crypto space is full of justifiable paranoia (and scams). I welcome any thoughts you devs might have regarding this. Thanks 🙏
